Element definition: Abbreviation of EEA Member or Collaborating Country.
Unique identifier of the spatial object.
Identifier defining the scheme used to assign the thematic identifier.
Unique international identifier of the monitoring site.
Value definitions: Is equal to the thematicIdIdentifier value, if spatial object is a monitoring site.

Element definition: Specification of whether the monitoring site is a WFD monitoring site ('euMonitoringSiteCode') or not ('eionetMonitoringSiteCode').
Value definitions:
eionetMonitoringSiteCode: EIONET identifier;
euMonitoringSiteCode: WFD identifier

Element definition: Name of the monitoring site
Unique international identifier of the water body being monitored.
Value definitions: Is equal to the thematicIdIdentifier value, if spatial object is a water body.

Element definition: Specification of whether the water body is a WFD water body ('euGroundwaterBodyCode' or 'euSurfaceWaterBodyCode') or not ('eionetGroundwaterBodyCode' or 'eionetSurfaceWaterBodyCode').
Name of the water body
Additional classification value which further specialises the type of management, regulation or restriction zone, represented by this spatial object.
Specification of whether a water body is identified as natural, artificial (AWB) or heavily modified (HMWB).
For heavily modified river or lake water bodies, the value indicates whether the water body is a reservoir that has been created by damming a river or an existing lake.
Member State code for the characterisation type of the surface water body under the WFD.
Unique international identifier of the river basin district sub-unit.
Value definitions: Is equal to the thematicIdIdentifier value, if spatial object is an RBD sub-unit.

Element definition: Identifier defining the scheme assigned to the spatial object identifier.
Name of the river basin district sub-unit.
Unique international identifier of the river basin district.
Value definitions: Is equal to the thematicIdIdentifier value, if spatial object is an RBD.

Element definition: Identifier defining the scheme assigned to the spatial object identifier.
Name of the river basin district.
Information about the sensitivity and confidentiality status of the monitoring site location.
Value definitions:
F: Free for publication;
N: Not for publication

Latitude of the monitoring site. It is not provided for monitoring sites where publication is restricted.
